description: Teenage boy of about sixteen, cocky, flippant and sarcastic, a pig farmer's son convinced he is a legendary warrior, quick with jokes and insults, cracking into panic, rage or real grief in a handful of scenes.
preview_text: He grew up in my village - I cannot turn my back on him. What, the house, mother nooooo!!! No.. there is a perfect explanation, you see, the friction seemed to cook and...

description: Young woman, earnest and sunny, a painter and the Mayor's daughter, polite, a little dreamy, urgent when the town is in danger.
preview_text: Yeah me too, everyone's happy as can be. I'll head back to the fountain and warn people. My god, look at this plan. The mayor's sometimes in here. Not really, no one's been here.

description: Man in his thirties, jumpy and informal, an escaped prisoner who talks a lot, dry and bitter about goblins, with lore delivered in long rambling explanations.
preview_text: I hope I can make it to PortTown and get away for a while. Anyway they said this guy could actually turn people to ice!! I've always wanted to go out into the world and find adventure.

description: Friendly middle-aged wanderer, chatty and relaxed, a natural lore-giver who explains things at length in a warm storytelling tone.
preview_text: AlkTree nuts??  Those make for a hearty meal.  Let's see.. Ow, crazy bastard!! If you ever run into goblins, be careful. So young man, what's your name?

description: Middle-aged farm mother, brisk, dry and affectionate, with deadpan patience for a sulky teenage son.
preview_text: Dink, it's getting late!  No food until you feed the pigs! Dink, can you do something for me? Of course not.  He was a wonderful farmer and husband. Dink, would you go feed the pigs?

description: Young man in his early twenties, an arrogant village bully turned knight, sneering and mocking, who later becomes weak, whispering and dying.
preview_text: Just passing through... what are you doing away from the farm? This has been fun, pig boy, but I have REAL adventuring to do.  See ya. Bawahahahah!  See you around, squirt.

description: Very old, very small wizard, prickly and pompous but kindly as a teacher, with a sudden booming temper when his size is mocked; also reads his letters aloud.
preview_text: Here Dink, take this.  This red potion will strengthen you. DON'T ANGER ME, HUMAN! If you would like to learn more.. Come to my hidden cabin. It's a great power and gift to those who can use it.

description: Warm, dignified older king with a gentle sense of humor, formal in speech and grave when speaking of the lost.
preview_text: I will have men there to guide you through the passage. SMALLWOOD HAS RETURNED! But... just getting to the darklands is quite a challenge... Now what is it I can help you with?

description: Ancient, malevolent being with a deep, calm, resonant voice and unhurried menace that swells into a roaring taunt in combat.
preview_text: I could finish you now, but this rather amuses me. FEEL MY WRATH, SMALLWOOD! I am everything you despise. Nice shot.  It will be your last. I am everything you love.

description: Goblin king, deep and imperious, fluent and articulate, bellowing with rage when his brothers lie dead and reduced to a weak plea when dying.
preview_text: Of course.  I was raised by.. what is this?  My comrades litter the ground! You?  YOU?  I MUST AVENGE MY BROTHERS! I will tell you where the secret Cast camp is...

description: Gruff, guttural goblins; most lines are invented gibberish to be read as an alien language with consistent sounds, and a few are childlike broken English.
example_characters: goblin, Goblin George, Goblin gate guard
preview_text: Hoglim dack byork! Oston tewers inat'l meen o mistary! Gro'k ki owab dakis gedi! no bow?!!! un not joon! leev!! they ar BAD.  they can oonly anderstund ONE theng.

description: Smooth, theatrical middle-aged cult leader, unctuous and sermonizing, with a gleeful cruelty underneath.
preview_text: Your blood will flow like the river Jordan. The girls are hungry - DINNER TIME! How goes the Dead Dragon Carcass worshipping, girls? Judgement day has cometh, sinner!

description: Cold, rough-voiced men of a criminal conspiracy, sneering and threatening, with short bursts of cruel laughter.
example_characters: Cast agent, Cast knight, Cast agent / bar thug
preview_text: You may live, if you forget all that you've seen here. Looks like you have trouble learning, small one. I thought I told you to stay away from us. Right.  Have you contacted Mog?

description: Young adult man, casual, energetic and slightly deadpan or hyperactive, an everyman.
preview_text: There go my chances of impressing the Mayor's daughter!!!! My ducks!!!!!!!! ALL DEAD!!!!!!! DAMN YOU! I don't know man, I just work here. What are you, some kind of freak?

description: Ordinary middle-aged man, an all-purpose voice that runs from tired and polite to gruff, anxious or angry.
example_characters: cave prisoner, Mr. SmileStein, Thief, hunter, Jack Kneedlewood, barkeep, Robinson Cabinets owner
preview_text: Actually, it was to stop a freak named Bishop Nelson. Guards!! Help me, destroy this madman! But they say a magic user came and cast a mighty spell on the castle.

description: Elderly man with a weathered, gravelly voice, cranky and rambling, a tall-tale teller or ex-sailor who has had a drink.
example_characters: Nathan, old man 2, Blistering Pete, hellfire man, old man 1
preview_text: Did I ever tell you about the time I trained a slayer? He's a PIG FARMER?! I suppose I'll be dead soon.  I'm not particularly worried. Nope.  If I did, I doubt I would want to live it.

description: Young adult woman, bright, direct and spirited, able to turn sharp, sorrowful or tearful.
example_characters: Libby SmileStein, Terris barmaid, Lyna, Sporty (pop-group cameo)
preview_text: Oh yes!  Hey, hero Smallwood just asked me out! You fool, of course not!!  He doesn't do that!! Nothing Dink, you wouldn't understand. There was nothing you could do..

description: Middle-aged woman, warm, worn and practical, alternating anxious motherly softness with fear or resolve.
example_characters: Aunt Maria Kneedlewood, Nadine, starving mother, parade spectator, letter from Aunt Maria, voice behind a door 2, Joppa mother
preview_text: This must be a hard time for you, being so young and suffering... Not the fists, not the fists!! It's in the King's News, there is a copy at the healers.

description: Elderly woman, quavering, fussy and sentimental, a little nosy and fond of a drink, breaking into hysterical grief.
preview_text: You must keep searching for Quackers!  I loved him! Hello murderer!! I'm so grateful to you, Dink!  You are wonderful! It's not your fault Dink. Oh Dink, look who is here!

description: Young girl of about six to ten, high and bright, by turns chirpy and gossipy, innocent, frightened or spoiled and screeching.
example_characters: Chealse, Mary, Jennifer, Promise, starving daughter, Cindy, Kelly
preview_text: Libby and her new boyfriend seem really happy together. He's a slayer shapeshifter!  No!!!! I think the Carcass would appreciate another sacrifice, Bishop Nelson.

description: Adult man in uniform, stolid and professional, a touch amused or wary, shouting when provoked.
example_characters: castle guard, duck altar guard, Guard Renton, Edge of the World guard (Tom's friend), Edge of the World guard Tom, Terris guard 1, Terris guard 2
preview_text: Sorry about what happened Dink, I hope you're ok. Dink is a hero!  WE MUST GO TELL THE OTHERS! King Daniel has ruled with an iron hand for nearly a decade now.

description: Shopkeeper of either sex, polite and practical, with smug or prim sales patter that turns meek when struck.
example_characters: bookstore clerk, furrier, Jill, Arturous, church shopkeeper, cobbler, shopkeeper
preview_text: That hurts and all, but you could be doing much more damage with a bow! I'm sorry sir, but you DON'T have enough gold! Um, sir?  It's stuffed.  It isn't alive... It won't hurt you.

description: Very old, absent-minded mage, dry and rambling, forgetful with names, muttering ancient lore.
preview_text: Why should I care what happens to this man? SMALLWOOD ?!? Well, if those Cast members are involved I'd best help. Thank you ... what is your name friend?

description: Deep, slow, growling beast that speaks in words through a snarl, menacing and boastful.
preview_text: Try your best but you risk your life doing so... Who dares enter my cave? You cannot win, Smallwood. RRrrr ar a rar a  arrgghhh. I sense someone in my domain.

description: Comic talking duck, deadpan and friendly, with a slight quacking nasal cadence, ranging from sulky to hearty.
example_characters: giant duck, duck fight host, Quackers, mother duck, talking bottle, magical tree-duck
preview_text: Hi, we are the giant ducks of Koka Isle. Quack.  No!! To bad, better luck next time. The bets are in, let's fight! Would you like to play with me? Too bad, better luck next time.

description: Eerie spectral voice of a dead mother or child, hollow and echoing, flat and plaintive, then shrieking.
example_characters: ghost girl, ghost mother, crazy ghost girl
preview_text: Last thing I remember is that group of knights.. and blood. LOOK UPON MY DEFORMED FACE! I feel so old.. yet why have I not aged? Some of us like to eat humans.  I would leave if I were you.

description: Vast, ancient dragon, a low rumbling slow voice, solemn and vengeful.
preview_text: Let us finish it. Run from us no more, humans.

description: Creaky, comical talking tree, timid and nasal, fond of puns and a cackling laugh.
preview_text: Please sir, don't hurt me, the talking tree of the east! Your magic is treely useless against me.. HAW HAW HAW! There is a rock near the Duck Idol with a crack in it...

description: Neutral, clear storyteller or reader voice for signs, posters and end-card text, warm, slightly wry and unhurried.
example_characters: sign, King's News poster, end card, magic voice (shareware advert), demo sign
preview_text: Or make your own, download the free development kit. YOU HAVE FINISHED THE GAME. By order of our great ducks the monthly tax shall be doubled. The King's News, issue 76.
